usedFor: SuperSaaS holds bookings and users, and Sangam CRM keeps the person as a lead through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Someone who books is a warm prospect, and the action records them by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Send Mail” in SuperSaaS switches off regular sending, so check that before using it as a trigger.
